title: Pluto Launcher
shortDescription: A calm Android home screen with controller-friendly Console mode and ROM tabs.
fullDescription:
Pluto is an Android launcher for everyday phone use and gaming handhelds. Rotate your device or connect a gamepad, and your apps, favourites, folders and categories stay together as the layout adapts.

YOUR EVERYDAY HOME SCREEN
• A clean home screen with a glass dock, favourites and folders.
• An alphabetical app drawer with search for apps, ROMs and supported app shortcuts.
• Portrait and landscape layouts, icon packs, widgets and adjustable icon and text sizes.
• Choose your wallpaper, Pluto’s planet background or animated console waves.
• Optional notification dots, swipe-down gestures and reduced motion.

CONSOLE MODE
• Browse apps and games in a landscape carousel with shelves and clear button hints.
• Use touch, a controller or a keyboard.
• Customize controller mapping, stick tuning and carousel appearance.
• Switch automatically when a controller is connected in landscape, or keep Console mode on.

YOUR ROM LIBRARY
• Create named ROM tabs and choose folders with Android’s file picker.
• Use your own local cover artwork and select a default emulator for each tab.
• Search your library alongside apps and launch games in compatible installed emulators.
• Games, BIOS files and emulators are supplied separately. Pluto does not download games.

LOCAL AND OPEN SOURCE
Pluto has no account, ads or analytics. Layouts, optional recent launches and ROM library records stay on your device. You can clear recent launches or turn history off. Source code is available under the MIT licence.

OPTIONAL ANDROID ACCESS
Notification access is used only for notification-dot metadata; Pluto does not read or store notification message text. The optional Accessibility Service API enables double-tap screen locking only. It cannot read screen content, does not monitor accessibility events, and does not collect or share personal data. Both features require your choice and can be disabled in Android Settings.

Requires Android 11 or newer. Work profile and Private Space apps are not supported in this version. Widgets occupy full rows of the home grid.
releaseNotes: First Google Play release. Customizable Home, richer app and ROM search, notification dots, controller-friendly Console mode and local ROM tabs. Google Play handles updates.
